title: Enrolment Request
description: Sent by an agent to begin enrolment. The only unauthenticated message in the protocol. Authenticated by office_code.

office_code.description: Office code in Crockford base32 format: HMD-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.

csr.description: Base64url-encoded PKCS#10 certificate signing request containing the agent's Ed25519 public key.

machine_fingerprint.description: Base64url-encoded 32-byte HMAC of stable hardware identifiers. The server pepper is never transmitted.

agent_version.description: Semver string for the agent version.

os.description: Operating system the agent is running on.
